lib.title: Ilayibrari
lib.subtitle: Imidlalo engu-{n} enenkqubo eyaziwayo · ihlaziywe ngo-{date}
lib.empty.title: Akukho nto ifunyenweyo
lib.empty.text: Zama elinye igama okanye uvule u-“Bonisa imidlalo engenayo i-exe”.
fav.title: Izintandokazi
fav.empty.title: Akukho nto apha okwangoku
fav.empty.text: Cofa inkwenkwezi kwithayile yomdlalo ukuyongeza apha.
detail.notInstalled: Akukho kopi ifakweyo ifunyenweyo, kwaye kulungile oko: i-decoy ayiyidingi.
detail.noteDone: Ungayimisa ngoku, imfuno yomsebenzi (quest) ifanele ukuba ibaliwe.
detail.noteRunning: Inkqubo iqhuba ngasemva. Unokuciphisa ifestile uyise kwitreyi yenkqubo.
detail.noExe.title: I-Discord ayikayazi i-exe yalo mdlalo
detail.noExe.text: Ayinakufunyanwa ngenkqubo. Cofa u-“Hlaziya uvimba weenkcukacha” kamva: zakuba i-Discord yongeze i-exe, umdlalo uya kufumaneka.
running.title: Iziqhuba ngoku
running.empty.title: Akukho nto iqhubayo
running.empty.text: Vula umdlalo kwilayibrari uze ucofe u-“Qala i-decoy”.
settings.title: Izicwangciso
settings.language.desc: Ulwimi lwesonxibelelwano. Iilwimi ezintsha zongezwa njengeefayile kwifolda ye-locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Mingaphi imizuzu yokugcina inkqubo iqhuba (iimfuno ze-Discord zidla ngokufuna eyi-15).
settings.autoStop.desc: I-decoy iyaziphelela ngokwayo xa ixesha lifikile.
settings.tray.desc: Ama-decoy ayaqhubeka nokusebenza logama i-app ikwitreyi.
settings.source.desc: Uluhlu lukawonke-wonke lwe-Discord · imidlalo engu-{n} · ihlaziywe ngo-{date}
settings.showNoExe.desc: Iingeniso apho i-Discord ingekayazi inkqubo okwangoku (azikwazi ukuqaliswa).
settings.dataDir.desc: Apho uluhlu lwemidlalo nezicwangciso zigcinwa khona.
settings.dataDir.portable: Imo ephathekayo: yonke into igcinwe ecaleni kwe-decoy.exe.
settings.legal: I-Decoy ayisebenzisi ithokheni yakho ye-Discord kwaye ayikwamkeli i-quest egameni lakho. Ukuxelisa inkqubo yomdlalo kusenokuchasana nemithetho ye-Discord, yisebenzise ngokwakho emngciphekweni.
toast.launched: “{name}” iqalisiwe imizuzu engu-{n}. I-Discord ifanele ukuyibona kwimizuzwana emalunga ne-15.
toast.timeUp: Ixesha liphelile, imfuno yomsebenzi (quest) ifanele ukuba ibaliwe
toast.refreshAdded: Uvimba weenkcukacha uhlaziyiwe: imidlalo emitsha engu-+{n}
lab.title: Ilebhu
lab.subtitle: Ithebhu eyimfihlo: iqala ama-decoy amaninzi ngaxeshanye.
lab.count.desc: Imidlalo ikhethwa ngokungacwangciswanga, leyo sele iqhuba iyatsitywa. Umdlalo ngamunye uqhuba imizuzu engu-{n} (ebekwe kwizicwangciso).
lab.warn: I-decoy nganye yinkqubo eyodwa enefestile. Ngaphezulu kwe-200–300 ngaxeshanye kusenokucothisa ikhompyutha yakho, elona nani liphezulu ngu-{max}.
notify.title: Ixesha liphelile
